title: Pre-LLM PII regex scan
description: Run regex detectors over user prompt and tool inputs before any LLM call; block or redact based on classification.
implementation: packages/backend/src/lib/pii.ts wired into /api/run-agent* and /api/free-agent pre-flight

title: Secret pattern detection
description: Detect Anthropic/OpenAI/AWS/GitHub style API keys in prompts; block egress and warn user.
implementation: packages/backend/src/lib/pii.ts secret table; same hook as PRV-001

title: Data classification enforcement
description: Every workflow run carries a classification (unclassified / protected_a / protected_b); enforced server-side.
implementation: classification column on workflow_run; deny LLM egress for protected_b unless target endpoint is Vertex

title: EntraID dynamic group mapping
description: Map AIM-G-{MINISTRY}-ALL_EMPLOYEES / -ALL_CONTRACTORS to ministry tenant on login.
implementation: Fastify auth plugin parses JWT 'groups' claim; populates req.user.ministry

title: Ministry-scoped row level security
description: Postgres RLS on every workflow/free-agent table by ministry_id.
implementation: RLS policies in migrations 0002+; ministry_id default from current setting

title: Role-based access control
description: Three roles: viewer / builder / admin. Tool palette adapts.
implementation: users.role column + Fastify preHandler RBAC check

title: Append-only audit log
description: Every LLM call and tool call appended to audit_log: who / when / classification / prompt-hash / tool-list / output-classification.
implementation: audit_log table + Fastify onSend hook in run-agent routes

title: Audit retention 7 years
description: Audit log retained 7 years per GoA retention schedule.
implementation: Nightly job archives >7y rows; never deletes pre-archive

title: Encryption in transit
description: TLS 1.2+ enforced end-to-end; HSTS preloaded.
implementation: Fastify behind GoA LB terminating TLS; HSTS header

title: Encryption at rest
description: Postgres at-rest encryption (AES-256) via GoA managed Postgres
implementation: Provided by managed Postgres; documented in ATO

title: Per-classification retention
description: Free-agent sessions: 30d unclassified / 90d protected_a / 1y protected_b then purge.
implementation: Nightly job; user export endpoint pre-purge

title: User data export
description: Self-serve export of all artifacts/blackboards/files
implementation: GET /api/me/export returns ZIP

title: LLM call consent banner
description: User must accept that prompt may leave GoA boundary unless using GoA-vetted endpoint.
implementation: Banner shown once per session; acceptance written to audit_log

title: Idle session timeout
description: 30 minutes idle / 8h absolute
implementation: Fastify session plugin

title: Per-user schema
description: Each user's analysis data lives in their own Postgres schema (lotanna_okwuchukwu etc.).
implementation: SCHEMA_NAME env-driven migrations

title: Output redaction (optional)
description: Optionally scan LLM output for PII; block if detected and target is unclassified channel.
implementation: packages/backend/src/lib/pii.ts onSend hook

title: Tool URL allowlist
description: Per ministry: api_call / web_scrape / db URLs require admin approval.
implementation: allowlist table joined per ministry; enforced in tool routes

title: Block private IP egress
implementation: Helper in packages/backend/src/lib/safeFetch.ts (planned)

title: Prompt hash not stored verbatim
description: Store SHA-256 of prompt + first 80 chars; never the full prompt unless classification permits.
implementation: Audit insert path hashes prompt before write

title: Cross-ministry sharing controls
description: Sharing a workflow across ministries requires admin from both ministries.
implementation: sharing_invite table + dual-approval flow
